t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 2 groups of gnomes: Red (pink, red, purple, brown) and Yellow ( blue, yellow, orange and green)Alternate between groups based on mushroom yield.Stayed with red group if it yield is 4+ mushrooms switch to yellow group if its yield is 3 or less if you switch and get 0 or 1 mushroom, you switched too early!

vb_textbox.text: This game have 8 different color of gnomes, which is split into 2 groups. these include Pink, Red, Purple and brown gnomes takes you to the basket. The blue, yellow , orange and green gnomes takes to the yellow basket. the amount of mushrooms you get here depends on how you are able to switch between these colors. example if you go with the group of gnomes that select the red basket and receive 4+ mushrooms, continue to go with the group that selects red basket. if its start giving you 3 or less mushrooms you should try and switch to the group that select yellow basket. Always know that, you switch group too early if you receive 1 or 0 after switching.
